items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Uh-huh' to the interviewer's description of Mr. Ellison as the interviewer's friend.

ctx.x: And there was a white gentleman that lived around here. He was a dear friend of mine until he died. He was the last white person in this community. His name was Mr. Ellison. He lived right across the street from me and he would sit on my lawn. We'd sit out there and talk and he told me about the great times and the great poker games that they had with Babe Ruth and Earl Sande, --
